blocks.p: The belt runs along the foot of the screen. The hands sit at its left end; then comes the strap, with the numbered slots and the buckle.

caption: Figure 30-1
The belt with an item in each hand.

blocks.p: From left to right the belt holds a watch worn on the left wrist, the off hand, the main hand, a gun's tab for its rounds, a watch worn on the right wrist, and the strap. Each slot on the strap shows its item with a condition strip under it.

blocks.note: On a controller the belt starts on slot 1. Left reaches the main hand, then the off hand.

marks.text: Then the strap: three numbered slots and the buckle.
The off hand is on the left and smaller, the main hand beside it. Each ring shows the item's condition.

sticky.text: The hands sit at the left end of the belt, then the strap.

caption: Figure 30-2
One item in both hands, top, and a loaded pistol, bottom.

blocks.p: In the lower picture a watch is worn on the right wrist. It sits between the tab for the rounds and the strap.

marks.text: One item in both hands: the main hand keeps its circle and ring, and the off hand peeks out from behind it.
12+1 is twelve in the magazine and one chambered.
A loaded gun shows its rounds on a tab out from under the main hand. One square per round.

sticky.text: A gun in the main hand adds a tab for its rounds.
